title.original: Crab: A Semantics-Aware Checkpoint/Restore Runtime for Agent Sandboxes
title.zh: Crab：代理沙箱的语义感知检查点/还原运行时
title.en: Crab: A Semantics-Aware Checkpoint/Restore Runtime for Agent Sandboxes

inclusion_reason.zh: Crab 以透明主机运行时连接 Agent 轮次语义和 OS 检查点后端，提供跨沙箱的恢复与调度机制。
inclusion_reason.en: Crab is a transparent host runtime bridging agent-turn semantics and OS checkpoint backends, providing recovery and scheduling across sandboxes.

abstract.zh: Crab 是 Agent 沙箱的语义感知检查点运行时，通过识别每轮真实 OS 副作用，仅在有恢复价值时保存状态并协调同宿主流量。
abstract.en: Crab is a semantics-aware checkpoint runtime for agent sandboxes that detects real OS effects per turn, checkpoints only recovery-relevant state, and coordinates host-wide traffic.

problem.zh: 仅保存对话无法恢复文件和进程副作用，而逐轮完整检查点在高密度 microVM/容器并置下成本过高。
problem.en: Chat-only recovery misses filesystem and process effects, while full per-turn checkpointing is prohibitively expensive under dense container or microVM co-location.

approach.zh: 主机侧 eBPF 检查器分类工具轮次的 OS 可见影响，协调器将必要检查点对齐 Agent 轮次并与模型等待重叠。
approach.en: A host-side eBPF inspector classifies OS-visible effects of each tool turn, while a coordinator aligns necessary checkpoints with agent turns and overlaps work with model wait time.

system_design.zh: Crab 由 eBPF 影响检查器、轮次边界协调器、现有 C/R 后端适配层和跨沙箱流量调度器组成，无需修改 Agent。
system_design.en: Crab combines an eBPF effect inspector, turn-boundary coordinator, adapters to existing checkpoint backends, and a host-scoped traffic scheduler without modifying agents.

key_results.zh: 在 Shell 与代码修复负载中，它恢复了完整状态正确性，同时显著削减检查点流量并保持接近无故障执行时间。
key_results.en: On shell and code-repair workloads, it restores complete-state correctness, sharply reduces checkpoint traffic, and remains close to fault-free execution time.

limitations.zh: 分类只能看到 OS 可观测副作用，依赖 eBPF 和受支持的 C/R 后端；外部 SaaS、网络副作用及语义级应用状态仍可能无法回滚。
limitations.en: Classification is limited to OS-observable effects and depends on eBPF and supported backends; external services, network side effects, and semantic application state may remain irreversible.

notes.zh: 上述非空 evaluation 字段和数值仅转录自官方 arXiv 摘要；摘要未披露的表格级条件、硬件与集群配置及更多对照项仍待全文审计。
notes.en: The non-empty evaluation fields and numbers above are transcribed only from the official arXiv abstract; table-level conditions, hardware and cluster configurations, and additional comparisons not stated there await full-text audit.
